name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Inpatient Admissions Datasets
description: Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions datasets contain harmonized Medicaid Analytic eXtract (MAX) and T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) inpatient admission products, including admission-level files and county/ZCTA aggregate counts.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Inpatient Admissions V1 Datasets
description: Harmonized Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions covering all states from 2000-2018, with cohort indicator flags (fee-for-service, dual-eligible, disabled, full-benefit) and county/ZCTA yearly and daily admission counts. State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Inpatient Admissions File
description: Admission-level file of Medicaid inpatient admissions harmonized across MAX and TAF, with admission year and cohort indicator flags (ffs_ind, dual_ind, disabled_ind, full_benefit_ind) from the denominator.

name: Daily County-Level Admission Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid inpatient admission counts (n_adm__<cohort>) and beneficiary counts (n_bene__<cohort>) by cohort. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only).
